# Brandie

> Autonomous content system for small businesses. Pick a playbook, hit start, and a full week of on-brand social posts is generated, sequenced, and waiting for you, every week, on its own.

Brandie is an AI brand studio that combines brand memory, audience intelligence (Jobs To Be Done), trend awareness, and a multi-agent creative pipeline (copywriter + creative director + image renderer) to produce branded social media graphics and a weekly content ritual for small business owners, creators, and agencies.
